primary_analysis: Run paired_binary_analysis_v1 on execution/raw_results.jsonl (result_schema_id=paired_binary_episode_v1, result_schema_version=1.0). Primary test: paired Baseline vs Guarded using exact paired-proportion (McNemar/exact) two-sided test; report absolute paired difference (guarded − baseline), 95% CI, and two-sided p-value (alpha=0.05). Apply preregistered failed_call_treatment = complete_pair_primary. Use execution_manifest counts (completed_episode_count=282, failed_episode_count=18) and execution/execution_log.jsonl for failure adjudication. Compatible adapter family: hosted_netops_gvr_v1.
secondary_analyses: Compute attack-success rates separately for Baseline and Guarded (report proportions and CIs) using paired_binary_episode_v1 records (excludes only pairs where both runs are technical failures).

If mutation-class labels are present in task_manifest (string-level, token-insertion, slot-override), compute exploratory subgroup acceptance rates and paired differences by mutation class (report raw p-values and BH-FDR q-values per preregistration).
sensitivity_analyses: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat any missing generative output as attack failed=0) applied to primary paired test.
Exclude benign-control and sanitization-induced exclusions per preregistered exclusion_rules (report counts and recompute primary estimand as sensitivity).
uncertainty_quantification: Report exact 95% CI for paired difference (paired-proportion exact/Clopper-Pearson where applicable) and bootstrap 95% CI for paired difference (resample by intent; 10,000 replicates or maximum feasible given stored artifacts). Report two-sided p-value (alpha=0.05) for primary test.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary confirmatory family: single preregistered Baseline vs Combined (Guarded) paired test at alpha=0.05. All other tests are exploratory; for exploratory families (e.g., mutation-class subgroup tests, multiple secondary endpoints) report Benjamini–Hochberg FDR-adjusted q-values but do not use them for confirmatory claims.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered contamination_plan: use stored SHA-256 artifact hashes and execution/execution_log.jsonl to detect flagged artifacts; embargo any artifacts flagged by deterministic safety checks; report counts of flagged/embargoed items and verifier-exception/timeouts (verifier_failure) from execution logs; include integrity-check hashes in manifest; do not release embargoed verbatim artifacts, only aggregated summaries and hashes as preregistered.
table_specifications: Table 1: Per-condition summary — columns: condition (Baseline, Guarded), N_pairs_included (pairs with ≥1 successful run), acceptance_rate (proportion accepted for deployment), 95% CI, model_call_count; source: execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution_manifest.

Table 2: Failure summary — columns: failure_type (model_api_failure, verifier_failure, parser_error), episode_count, paired_exclusions_count (pairs excluded because both runs failed); source: execution/execution_log.jsonl and execution_manifest (failed_episode_count=18).

Table 3: Sensitivity results — rows: primary (complete_pair_primary), sensitivity (complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity), reported metrics: paired_difference, 95% CI, p-value; source: re-run analyses on execution/raw_results.jsonl.
figure_specifications: Figure 1: Bar chart of acceptance rates by condition (Baseline vs Guarded) with 95% CIs; data from paired_binary_episode_v1 records in execution/raw_results.jsonl.

Figure 2: Paired-difference plot (per-intent guarded − baseline: points with jitter), with histogram inset of paired differences; data from paired records in execution/raw_results.jsonl (only intents not excluded by preregistered rules).
Figure 3: Failure-mode waterfall: counts by failure_type across execution batches (batch_1..batch_3) using execution/execution_log.jsonl and execution_manifest.
